  FROM `cs-512516.logs_ingest.live_docker_ingested_logs` AS log_record
), extracted_logs AS (
  SELECT
    record,
    source_priority,
    SAFE_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.timestamp'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.time')) AS TIMESTAMP) AS timestamp,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.service'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.service'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.resource.labels.container_name')) AS service,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.cluster_name'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.cluster_name'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.resource.labels.cluster_name')) AS cluster_name,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.severity'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.severity')) AS severity,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.namespace'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.namespace'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.resource.labels.namespace_name'), 'meridian-prod') AS namespace,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.reason'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.reason')) AS reason,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.event_type'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.event_type')) AS event_type,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.textPayload'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.text_payload')) AS text_payload,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.pod_name'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.pod_name'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.resource.labels.pod_name')) AS pod_name,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.error_scenario'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.error_scenario')) AS error_scenario,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.message'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.message')) AS message,
    COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.trace_id'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.trace'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.log_gapis_trace'), JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.trace')) AS trace_id,
    COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.status_code') AS INT64), SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.status_code') AS INT64), SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.httpRequest.status') AS INT64)) AS status_code,
    COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.latency_ms') AS FLOAT64), SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.latency_ms') AS FLOAT64)) AS latency_ms,
    COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.cpu_utilization_pct') AS FLOAT64), SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.cpu_utilization_pct') AS FLOAT64)) AS cpu_utilization_pct,
    COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.memory_used_mb') AS FLOAT64), SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(record, '$.jsonPayload.memory_used_mb') AS FLOAT64)) AS memory_used_mb
  FROM raw_logs
), logs AS (
  SELECT * EXCEPT (record, source_priority)
  FROM extracted_logs
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY IF(error_scenario = 'injected_container_error', trace_id, record)
    ORDER BY source_priority
  ) = 1
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, MINUTE) AS time,
  CONCAT(service, ' / ', cluster_name) AS metric,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(severity = 'ERROR' OR status_code >= 500) * 100.0, COUNT(*)) AS value
FROM logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND service IN ('storefront-ui', 'order-service')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
